brief.aim: The table was evidently assembled to predict abalone age via the ring count from physical measurements, so Rings is the single numeric outcome and the seven dimension/weight columns plus Sex are predictors; no column is a component or post-outcome recoding of Rings, and there are no row keys, groups, or chronological fields to constrain.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeated-subject structure; each row is a distinct specimen with no subject or recording key.
brief.unit: One abalone specimen (physical shell measurement record)
